latestVersion.changelog:
Initial beta release: Diagnose Alibaba Cloud ECS GPU instances, check device/drivers, and report hardware issues.

- Guides users through checking prerequisites (Alibaba Cloud CLI, permissions) and gathering input parameters (instance ID, region).
- Validates instance ID and region, and ensures only supported Linux OS is diagnosed.
- Automates creation of GPU diagnostic reports and polling for results.
- Provides clear output summarizing GPU status, discovered issues, and recommended remediation measures.
- Includes detailed mapping of diagnostic issues to user instructions and special reminders for O&M notifications.
